items.title: Witch Filling a Potion Bottle
items.alt: A witch pours turquoise potion through a funnel into a bottle.
items.description: A focused witch pours a small ladle of turquoise liquid through a funnel into one corked-style bottle on a simple tabletop, with the cork set beside it. Use this illustration for personal crafts, storytelling and classroom projects.

items.title: Witch Stirring a Rainbow Brew
items.alt: An elderly witch stirs a cauldron beneath three colorful bubbles.
items.description: A cheerful elderly witch stirs a low round cauldron with a long spoon using both hands; three large colorful bubbles float above it. Use this illustration for personal crafts, storytelling and classroom projects.

items.title: Witch Looking through a Telescope
items.alt: A young witch looks through a brass telescope on a wooden tripod.
items.description: A young witch looks through a short brass telescope on a three-legged tripod, with one hand on the eyepiece and the other resting at her hip. Use this illustration for personal crafts, storytelling and classroom projects.
